Files copied: dist/bundle.js (see Modification below), images/icons, images/logo.svg, images/favicon.png (unmodified)

Modification (the only one): dist/bundle.js shipped with the upstream author's Pixabay and Google
Fonts API keys embedded. Both values were replaced with empty strings ("pixabay_key" and
"google_webfonts_key"). Programs on this site have no external network access, so those features
are unavailable either way, and third-party keys are not redistributed. MIT permits modification.
sha256 of the modified bundle.js: 790d028ec3b1f496b93b718cf7daf93a339e8bedf6d5f49503e840672a5be1e4
